scene_generation.rule: 背景与环境必须用文字生成描述，不依赖参考图

effects.breaking_frame: Breaking frame: the subject bursts out from paper/frame/screen with rough torn edges and 3D pop-out
effects.torn_paper: Torn paper: rough torn paper edges, flying paper scraps, layered paper surfaces
effects.collage: Collage: magazine cutouts, layered paper fragments, tape marks, scattered layout
effects.double_exposure: Double exposure: subject silhouette overlaid with another scene or pattern, semi-transparent blend
effects.newspaper_cutout: Newspaper cutout: black-and-white newspaper fragments, torn headlines, collage composition
effects.oversized_number: Oversized number: giant numeral as visual anchor, subject in front of or behind it
effects.circular_typography: Circular typography: text wrapping 360 degrees around the subject or element
effects.grid_infographic: Grid infographic: thin-line grid divisions, small codes, barcodes, data charts
effects.crosshair_target: Crosshair target: cross lines, concentric circles, targeting reticles overlaying the subject
effects.high_contrast_blocks: High contrast blocks: large solid color blocks dividing the background
effects.film_burn: Film burn: film edge burns, light leaks, scratches
effects.noise_grain: Noise grain: heavy noise, rough texture, vintage print feel

paradigms.typography_as_shape: Typography as shape: text forming a specific graphic shape
paradigms.dense_editorial: Dense editorial: multi-layer dense text with extreme size variation
paradigms.circular_arc: Circular arc: text wrapping around the central element in an arc
paradigms.asymmetrical_grid: Asymmetrical grid: non-symmetrical grid divisions with misaligned text and image fill
paradigms.text_through_subject: Text through subject: text interleaving in front of and behind the subject
paradigms.huge_plus_tiny: Huge + tiny: one giant main character accompanied by a swarm of tiny text
paradigms.vertical_horizontal_mix: Vertical + horizontal mix: Chinese-English mixed, vertical and horizontal combined, staggered stacking
paradigms.circular_crosshair: Circular crosshair: text and graphics wrapping around a central target
paradigms.newspaper_headline: Newspaper headline: ultra-bold headline + dense small text columns
paradigms.ticket_voucher: Ticket voucher: dashed dividers, perforated edges, ticket stub style
paradigms.journal_collage: Journal collage: handwriting + polaroid + washi tape + sticky notes
paradigms.glitch_offset: Glitch offset: torn and offset text, RGB separation, pixelation

text_rendering_rules.multi_line_rule: 每行分别用引号包裹，并注明行位置
text_rendering_rules.small_font_rule: 小字号文本需声明 small but legible text
text_rendering_rules.clarity_guarantee: text is clearly readable, clean typography, high contrast

ai_generation_guidelines.consistency: 与用户已提供部分保持风格一致
